record_boundary.rule: Normalized records are catalog inputs to classify. A link, description, or aggregate official-course reference is not promoted into a teachable official unit without retrieved unit-level evidence.
record_boundary.graph_effect: Only the manager-authored kickoff is a graph node. No official course sequence is inferred, and a one-node graph therefore has no dependency edges.

classifications.reason: The record is explicitly marked as a catalog overview and not an official course unit.
The record supplies course links but no retrieved unit definition.
Recordings are only described as being on the course website.
The snapshot contains a title and unresolved reference label, not accessible unit content.
Although associated with official coursework, it summarizes ten projects collectively and contains no project boundaries, specifications, dependencies, or validation artifacts.

record_boundary.future_expansion_gate: A later job may add official-unit nodes only after authorized retrieval establishes each unit's title, scope, ordering, provenance, availability, and validation boundary.
